correctness.rationale: Every rally assumption and initial-server convention is fixed. The four-stage score-event matrix is derived by a convergent geometric sum. A twelve-equation deuce system and exact row Green cancellation are checked algebraically. A telescoping first-hit decomposition and a formal diagonal identity yield the Legendre formula for all integer n>=2. Standard fixed-angle Legendre asymptotics plus algebraic-integer irrationality imply the exact signed envelope and infinitely many reversals. Independently organized exact-rational DP verifies targets 2..31, but finite tests are not the proof.

value.rationale: The source paper highlights the previously surprising target-dependent sign. The new globally exact Legendre evaluation proves that reversals occur infinitely often and quantifies the unusually rapid, sharp first-serve fairness correction. This is a structurally motivated probability law in an authentic stochastic sport model, not a fixed-score table, arbitrary parameter slice, or generic restatement of the matrix method.
